title: Decision trees: depth, purity, and reading one out loud

videos.script: Is the rating at most three point six? If yes, has the subscriber complained? {{questions}} Two questions, and you are in a group where two people in five leave. {{leaf}} That is a decision tree. A model made of questions, chosen by the data, one cut at a time. {{tree}} Each cut is the one that leaves the two halves least mixed. You will compute that by hand. {{purity}} Let it grow, and it improves on the rows it learned from at every level. On the test months, it improves to depth six, and then gets worse. {{depth}} Small trees can be read out loud, like a list of rules. Large ones cannot. {{read}} A tree for delivery times is a staircase. Past the longest delivery it has seen, it goes flat for ever. {{steps}} And fit five trees on five halves of the data, and they disagree below the first question. That weakness is exactly what the next lesson turns into a strength. {{end}}
